name: web-hr-monitor
description: A minimal web + Android app for recording heart-rate sessions to CSV using Web Bluetooth / native Android BLE

scripts.android:sync: npm run build:android && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:assembleDebug: npm run android:sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:assembleRelease: npm run android:sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease
